title: 睡
teacherNotes: Approved handoff for Production C. Latest origin/main production curriculum is complete through L250; L251-L256 are provisional dependencies, so this package is blocked from merge until those dependencies enter main. Use Taiwan usage: 睡著, not 睡着; 睡死了 is colloquial deep sleep and must not be visualized as death or horror.

generationConstraints.allowedBoundary: Use latest origin/main learned characters through L250 plus provisional learned chars [重, 沙, 張, 椅, 累, 死] plus current new char 睡.
imageRules: Generate square image / 1:1 composition for each sentence.
Use L058 lesson images only as illustration style references; do not copy any L058 person, clothing, face, hair, or body shape.
Use protagonist family identity anchors from L154/L162/L163 for protagonist mother, father, and little girl.
Every human prompt must explicitly name the role identity.
No written text, numbers, signs, labels, zhuyin, watermarks, logos, brands, wall writing, readable marks, horror imagery, injury, or death imagery.
Each image must clearly match its approved image notes and remain phone-readable in a square crop.
audioRules: Use repo OpenAI audio flow only.
Generate charAudio for 睡 as public/assets/lessons/L257/audio/char-u7761.m4a from the single character.
Generate G02 prefix/suffix and G05 wrong-option audio as standalone whole-text files from exact text.
Do not splice, cut, mute, patch, or extract production audio.

approvedSentences.text: 媽媽累了，坐在椅子上睡著了。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 媽媽累了坐在椅子上睡著了
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角媽媽工作或家務後很累，坐在椅子上睡著了。主角媽媽身份要符合 L154/L162/L163 family continuity，不可畫成老師；畫面溫和安靜，不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 爸爸睡死了，什麼都聽不見。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 爸爸睡死了什麼都聽不見
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角爸爸在家裡熟睡，主角小女孩或主角媽媽在旁邊小聲叫他，但爸爸完全沒聽見。畫面要表現「睡死了」是睡得很熟的誇張口語，不可呈現死亡、受傷或恐怖畫面；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

approvedSentences.text: 玩沙玩得太累，一到家就睡著。
approvedSentences.spokenText: 玩沙玩得太累一到家就睡著
approvedSentences.imageNotes: 主角小女孩在海邊或沙地玩沙後回到家，坐在沙發或椅子旁很快睡著。畫面可帶一點沙地玩耍後的物品，例如小沙桶或鞋上的沙，但場景在家裡；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。
主角爸爸和主角小女孩在家裡下棋，棋盤上有一步明顯走錯，兩人看著棋盤思考。畫面重點是棋局，不要出現任何死亡、恐怖或暴力意象；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。
乾淨溫暖的臥室裡，床邊放著一張小椅子，床和椅子的相對位置要清楚。畫面不需要人物；不可有文字、數字、標籤或水印。

stage4Plan.reason: 「爸爸睡死了」是本課核心口語用法，目標字清楚。
